test_cases.description: Verify the installed Evidence Lane runtime and native MCP identity without mutation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check the Evidence Lane runtime health and show its native MCP server identity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a PASS or fail-closed runtime receipt with release identity, checks, and the native Evidence Lane MCP route.

test_cases.description: Inspect the locked ENV/UOP Flash package without changing its receipt.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify the locked Evidence Lane ENV/UOP Flash package and show whether every authority member passes.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the immutable Flash verification status, member hashes, SQLite integrity, and any explicit warning without writing state.

test_cases.description: Read the accepted project version, pointer generation, active session, candidate, and HIL boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show status for Evidence Lane project test-codex-evidence-lane-plugin without changing its accepted pointer.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns accepted-PV and pointer facts, active-session state, pending-candidate state, and project routing with no lifecycle effect.

test_cases.description: Search only accepted project evidence and retain source provenance.
test_cases.user_prompt: In project test-codex-evidence-lane-plugin, search the accepted evidence for the ChatGPT plugin metadata contract.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded accepted-PV matches with source references, hashes, and authority labels rather than inventing unsupported project facts.

test_cases.description: Render the governed accepted-pointer and HIL panel through the plugin-owned MCP Apps UI.
test_cases.user_prompt: Render the governed project panel for test-codex-evidence-lane-plugin and show the accepted pointer and HIL boundary.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns structured read-only project facts for the branded Evidence Lane MCP Apps panel without accepting, rejecting, rolling back, or promoting.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Evidence Lane for unrelated weather information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Will it rain in New York tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because live weather is outside Evidence Lane project-evidence workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Evidence Lane for an unrelated calendar request.
